fields.title: 📖 Ḥayāʾ brings only good
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said, or transmitted:

> ***“Ḥayāʾ brings only good.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Shame before Allah and before what is ugly preserves dignity, boundaries, and the purity of the heart.

immutable.source: 📝 Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī; Überlieferung von ʿImrān b. Ḥuṣayn.
